summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Cemex, S.A.B. de C.V., a foreign private issuer, announcing a routine cash dividend payment approved at its Ordinary General Shareholders' Meeting (AGM). The filing details the first installment of $45 million, with per-share amounts of MXN 0.017873 per share (≈USD 0.001039) and USD 0.031170 per ADS, paid on June 18, 2026 for shares/CPOs and around June 29, 2026 for ADS holders. The dividend comes from the CUFIN account with no withholding. No special-situation event is involved.
